name: Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-14 PREP N PRIME IMPACT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, May 2026, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/sikafloor-14-prepnprimeimpact.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is a specialty solvent free, ready to use non porous primer designed for use over smooth and non-porous surfaces and substrates.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor, SikaTile, Davco and other relevant Sika product ranges. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is suitable for priming over the following fully binded and thoroughly cleaned surfaces:
    - Ceramic and porcelain tiles
    - Terazzo
    - PVC control leak flanges and metal drain flanges prior to waterproofing
    - Non-porous coatings
    - Sika waterbased vapour/moisture barriers such as
    - Sikalastic Moisture Seal and Sikafloor-158W Fast Barrier
    - Vinyl flooring (non cushion backed)
    - Sika acrylic membranes
    - Non porous construction boards and sheets.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A SOLVENT FREE NON-POROUS PRIMER
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Product characteristic and benefits. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is a solvent-free, single-component non-porous primer engineered to deliver superior adhesion on sound, smooth, and non-absorbent substrates. Formulated with post-consumer recycled materials and incorporating patent-pending technology, this environmentally responsible primer boasts exceptionally low VOC emissions, positioning it as a sustainable solution for both interior and exterior applications.
2.3 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Sika customers benefit from.
    - A sustainable solution that supports reducing our carbon footprint.
    - Refer to the sustainability Factsheet for more information.
2.4 Certificates and test reports. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact Patent Pending.
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - A sustainable solution that supports reducing our carbon footprint. Refer to the sustainability Factsheet for more information.
    - Single component - premixed, ready to apply
    - Solvent free - Manufactured with recycled materials reducing CO2 emissions and Carbon Footprint
    - Non-porous primer prior to Sikafloor levelling or smoothing compounds
    - Non-porous primer prior to tiling with SikaTile or Davco systems
    - Non-porous primer prior to waterbased waterproofing membranes
    - Fast drying, ready for covering after 50+ mins
    - Easy application - bruch or roller applied
    - Dries with a grip/rough finish promoting a keyed surface, for improved bond with susequent materials
    - Time saving alternative to mechanical grinding of surfaces such a tiles and non-porous substrates
    - Suitable as a primer for resin backed tile and stone (conduct a bond test first)
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Grey liquid with fine aggreagate
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Recycled content: Up to 15% recycled raw material content.
2.8 System structure.
    | Non-porous System | Moisture/Vapour Barrier System |
    | Clean non-porous surface | Concrete subfloor up to 98% RH (2 |
    | coats) |
    | Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact | Sikalastic Moisture Seal or Sikafloor |
    | 158W Fast Barrier (2 coats) |
    | Subsequent suitable Sika product | Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact |
    | Subsequent suitable Sika product |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 10Ltr & 4Ltr pail sizes.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacture if unopened.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight. Do not allow the product to freeze.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - The substrate must have adequate strength, load bearing capacity, dimensional stability and be dry. All substratss must be clean, dry and free of residues which reduce adhesion, e.g. dust, dirt, oil, grease, wax, cleaning agents and loose particles. 100% solids epoxy must be applied more than 24hrs before Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact can be applied.
    - When applying over exisiting tiles ensure the tiles are well bonded. Glossy tiles should be sanded to remove the gloss finish.
    - When installing over old flooring/coatings Sika® recommends mechanical abrasion (sanding/grinding) be carried out to achieve fresh non-contaminated surface, with coating having a minimum pull off strength of 1.5MPa. This is to be followed by a thorough clean prior to installing Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact & subsequent Sika® products.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 8-10m² per lite dependant on substrate texture and profile.
4.3 Substrates.
    - Ceramic and porcelain tiles
    - Terazzo*
    - PVC and Metal control leak flanges and pipe penetrations prior to waterproofing
    - Non-porous coatings*
    - Acrylic membranes*
    - Non-porous construction sheeting and boards*
    *Note: conduct a bond test prior to priming application to verify suitability
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. Before applying subsequent flooring products Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact must be completely dry (50min+ @ 23°C). Do not install products over wet or pooling Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, Instead, brush the pooling product out and wait till dry. When priming resin backed stone allow primer to dry for 3 hours (at 23°C & 50% RH). In cool or cold climate drying time will be extended.
4.5 Equipment. Paint brush or medium nap roller
4.6 Mixing. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is premixed, however stirring the product prior to use is recommeded.
4.7 Application.
    - Apply a single coat with a paint brush or medium nap paint roller or paint brush to provide a continuous coating to the substrate.
    - Allow primer to dry and harden prior to flooring, levelling, tiling or subsequent coatings.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment.
    - Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the material drying.
    - Dried product shall require mechanical removal.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous areas first to ensure compatabilty. Bond testing is considered good practice and is recommended by Sika to verify product suitability prior to overcoating
    - Do not apply Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact over concrete surfaces, use a Sika porous primer
    - Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact should not be applied over solvent based finishes
    - Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact may only be applied over SikaTile® or Davco® acrylic membranes Sikafloor® 100% Solids Epoxy must be cured for at least 24hrs before the application of Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact.
    - Do not apply on damp or wet substrates
    - Polished or high gloss tiles shall be sanded or abraded to remove high gloss finish prior to application.
    - Ensure Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is fully dry prior to subsequent applications of membranes and other coatings.
    - Not suitable over tiles and natural stone that have sealers previously applied.
    - When used over existing tile ensure tiles are sound and well bonded.
    - Do not use Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact in areas or permanent water exposure. Ensure applications externally are applied over falls to wastes and avoid ponding.
    - For uses not mentioned in this document contact Sika Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Apply between +5°C to 35°C
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - *Note: conduct a bond test prior to priming application to verify suitability
    - Test product in an inconspicuous areas first to ensure compatabilty. Bond testing is considered good practice and is recommended by Sika to verify product suitability prior to overcoating
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, May 2026, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/sikafloor-14-prepnprimeimpact.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, version 31/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sds-sikafloor-14prepnprimeimpact.pdf
    - Document: Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact Sustainability Fact Sheet, version 26/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/Sikafloor-14%20Prep%20N%20Prime%20Impact%20Sustainability%20Fact%20Sheet%20(1).pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
